claim: Simulated people mediate nearly all transactions
originalWording: Simulated people mediate nearly all transactions

sources.title: Spiritual Machines: The Merging of Man and Machine — Ray Kurzweil
sources.locator: P02 Business in 2019, simulated-person transactions bullet

sourceCaveat: The original book edition has not been independently checked. See the listed source and full record for attribution limits.

reference.criterion: The vast majority of transactions involve an AI-like simulated person, often agent-to-agent without direct human involvement.
reference.rationale: Ordinary online checkout and payment automation in 2019 were not predominantly simulated-person interactions. Agent payment protocols and commercial conversational-commerce offerings now make the direction concrete. They do not establish the original vast-majority share.
